title: scAtlasScout Output Schema
description: Schema for the top-level response returned by the scAtlasScout skill, wrapping an array of dataset records with query metadata.

query_interpretation.description: Human-readable note describing how the input query was interpreted, including any abbreviation expansions and synonyms applied. Example: '"LUAD" → lung adenocarcinoma (+ synonyms: lung cancer, NSCLC, pulmonary adenocarcinoma)'

total_count.description: Total number of dataset records returned after filtering and deduplication.

source_counts.description: Breakdown of result counts by source database.

GEO.description: Number of records sourced from GEO.

SRA.description: Number of records sourced from SRA.

CellxGENE.description: Number of records sourced from CellxGENE.

platform_breakdown.description: Count of datasets per inferred platform label. Keys are platform label strings (e.g., '10X Chromium', 'Smart-seq2', 'Unknown'). Values are integer counts.

warnings.description: List of warning messages generated during retrieval or processing (e.g., unavailable sources, partial results).

datasets.description: Ordered array of dataset records, ranked by species preference, platform preference, cell count, and recency.

DatasetRecord.title: DatasetRecord
DatasetRecord.description: A single dataset record representing one scRNA-seq or snRNA-seq study from GEO, SRA, or CellxGENE.

accession.description: Primary dataset identifier. Valid formats: GSE followed by digits (GEO), SRP/ERP/DRP followed by digits (SRA), or a UUID (CellxGENE).

source.description: The database from which this record was retrieved.

title.description: Full dataset title as recorded in the source database.

platform.description: Inferred or stated sequencing platform. Canonical values: '10X Chromium', 'Smart-seq2', 'Drop-seq', 'inDrops', 'MARS-seq', 'sci-RNA-seq', 'Microwell-seq', 'Unknown'.

platform_confidence.description: Confidence score for the platform inference, ranging from 0.0 (no evidence) to 0.9 (explicit platform field). See rules/platform_inference_rules.md.

cell_or_sample_count.description: Cell count (preferred) or sample count. Format: '<N> cells' or '<N> samples'. Use comma-separated thousands formatting.

year.description: 4-digit year of dataset submission or publication.

url.description: Direct URL to the dataset record in the source database, or to the associated publication DOI.

is_duplicate_flag.description: Set to true if this record is a suspected duplicate of another record in the results. See rules/filtering_rules.md for duplicate detection criteria.

notes.description: Optional free-text notes, such as duplicate warnings, missing DOI notices, or platform conflict annotations.
